spans.s:
r. 2nd cl. (वेत्ति वेदि)
To know.
With नि prefixed,
To be sad or depressed.
With सम्,
(संवित्ते)
To meditate, to know, to gain holy knowledge by abstract meditation.
r. 4th cl. (विद्यते)
To be, to exist, to be present, to exist actually.
r. 7th cl. (विन्ते)
To consider, to reason.
r. 10th cl. (वेदयते)
1 To be sensible.
2 To know.
3 To declare, to describe or explain; (in this sense नि is usually prefixed.)
4 To dwell, to inhabit.
5 To be fixed or steady.
6 To suffer pain.
With नि, or वि and नि prefixed,
To deliver, to impart or communicate.
With प्रति,
To deliver, to give.
(औ ऌ) औ विटॢ r. 6th cl. (विन्दति-ते)
To gain, to get, to acquire or possess.
With परि,
To marry first.

Knowledge.
2

Intellect, understanding.
E.
विद to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (वित्)
Who or what knows.
E.
विद् to know, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
1 Clever, shrewd, knowing.
2 Sharp, witty.
3

Intriguing.
4

Undigested.
5

Burnt.
m. (-ग्धः)
1 A libertine, a lecher, an intriguer.
2 A learned or clever man, a scholar, a Paṇḍita.
f. (-ग्धा)
A sharp knowing woman.
E.
वि before दह to burn, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Sharpness, shrewdness, cleverness, wit.
E.
तल् aff. of the abstract, added to the last; also with त्व aff. विदग्धत्वं.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Wise, intelligent, learned, knowing.
E.
विद to know, aff. शतृ.

m. (-थः)
1 A wise or learned man, a sage, a scholar.
2 A saint, a devotee.
E.
विद to know, Uṇādi aff. अथ, and the radical vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्)
Having, wearing, assuming.
E.
वि before धा to have, शतृ aff.

m. (-रं)
Tearing, rending.
n. (-रं)
The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.)
E.
वि before दृ to tear, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 Tearing, rending.
2 War, battle.
3 An inundation, an overflow, the rising of a river or pond above its banks.
f. (-री)
1 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
2 A climbing plant, (Ipomoea paniculata.)
3 Bubo, swelling in the groin, &c.
E.
वि before दृ to tear, to divide, aff. घञ्.

mf. (-र्भः-र्भा)
A district and city to the south-west of Bengal, the modern Bara-Nagpur or Berar proper.
m. (-र्भः)
Any dry or desart soil.
E.
वि privative, and दर्भ the sacred grass; not growing in that country in consequence of the curse of a saint, whose son had died of a wound from a blade of the grass.

f. (-जा)
1 The wife of the saint

AGASTYA.
2

DAMAYANTĪ the wife of NALA, and heroine of the Naiṣadha or poem so called.
3 RUKMIṆĪ the wife of KṚṢṆA.
E.
विदर्भ the country, and ज born.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Opened, expanded, blown, (as a flower, &c.)
2 Rent, split.
n. (-लं)
1 A shallow basket made of split bambus, a vessel of wicker work.
2 Split peas.
3 Pomegranate bark.
4 The cuttings or chips of any substance, that which has been pared or split.
m. (-लः)
1 Dividing, separating.
2 A cake.
3 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.)
E.
वि before दल tearing, splitting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rent, torn, split.
2 Blown, expanded, (as a flower.)
E.
वि before दल to tear, क्त aff.

n. (-णं)
Rending, dividing.
E.
विदल, and करण making, with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Divided, separated.
2 Cut, split, torn, broken.
E.
विदल dividing, कृत made, and च्चि augment.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being bitten.
E.
वि before दशि to bite, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A divider, a render or tearer.
2 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream, dividing its course.
3 A hole or pit for water sunk in the bed of a dry river, &c.
f. (-रिका)
1 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
2 A bubo.
E.
वि before दृ to divide, aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-णं)
1 Tearing, breaking, splitting, severing, dividing.
2 Paining, afflicting.
3 Killing, slaughter.
nf. (-णं-णा)
War, battle.
m. (-णः)
A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.)
E.
वि before दृ to tear, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Tearing, rending, dividing.
E.
वि before दृ to tear, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Torn, rent, split, broken.
E.
वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
E.
विदारी a plant, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-रुः)
A lizard.
E.
वि before दृ to tear, उ aff.

ind. (-र्य्यः)
Having torn or rent.
E.
वि, and दॄ to tear, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Heat, burning.
2 Pungency.
E.
वि before दह to burn, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
1 Burning, hot.
2 Pungent, acrid.
E.
वि before दह to burn, aff. घिनुण्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A sort of bird.
E.
विदिश् a point of the compass, and चङ्ग handsome.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, understood.
2 Promised, agreed, assented.
3 Represented, submitted, solicited.
4 Apprised, informed, who or what knows.
m. (-तः)
A sage, a learned man.
n. (-तं)
Information, representation.
E.
विद to know, &c., aff. क्त.

ind.
1 Having known.
2 Having promised.
E.
विद to know, क्ता aff.

f. (-दिक्)
An intermediate point of the compass.
E.
वि implying separation, and दिश् a quarter.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Torn, split, burst or broken.
2 Expanded, opened.
E.
वि before दृ to tear, aff. क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being torn, split, broken, cut, &c.
E.
वि before दॄ to rend, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-दुः)
1 The hollow between the frontal globes of an elephant.
2 The hippopotamus.
E.
विद to know, (the goad,) aff. कु; also with कू aff. विदू.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wise, knowing, intelligent.
m. (-रः)
1 A libertine, an intriguer.
2 A learned or clever man.
3 The younger brother and counsellor of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
विद to know, कुरच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very far or remote.
E.
वि intervening, and दूर distant.

m. (-लः)
A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang); also the same growing in water, (C. fasciculatus.)
2 Gum myrrh.
E.
विद to know, &c., Uṇādi aff. उलच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Agitated, distressed.
E.
वि, and दु to distress, क्त aff.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Spreading, going far or wide.
E.
वि before दूर far, remote, and ग what goes.

n. (-जं)
The lapis lazuli.

m. (-द्रिः)
The name of a mountain.
E.
विदूर remote, and अद्रि a mountain.

mfn. (-कः-षिका-कं)
1 Facetious, witty, a wag, a jester.
2 Censorious, detracting, a detractor or abuser of other people.
m. (-कः)
1 An actor, especially an interlocutor with the audience between the acts or scenes, a jester, a buffoon.
2 (In dramatic language,) The humble and jocose companion of the principal character.
3 A catamite.
E.
वि before दूष to be or make bad, aff. क्कुन्.

n. (-णं)
Censuring, reviling, abuse, satire.
E.
वि before दूष to make bad or faulty, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-शः)
1 A foreign country, abroad.
2 Any place away from home.
E.
वि variety, देश place or country.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone abroad.
E.
विदेश, and गत gone.

n. (-नं)
Travelling, going abroad.
E.
विदेश, and गमन going.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Foreign, exotic.
E.
विदेश, and ज born.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Who or what remains abroad.
E.
विदेश, and स्थ what stays.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Foreign, foreigner, exotic.
E.
विदेश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Incorporeal, without body.
m. (-हः)
A sovereign of the family of JANAKA, king of Mithilā.
f. (-हा)
A district in the province of Behar, the same as the ancient Mithilā, or the modern Tirhut.
E.
वि privative, and देह the body.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Pierced, perforated.
2 Thrown, cast, directed, sent.
3 Like, resembling.
4 Opposed, impeded.
5 Beaten, whipped.
m. (-द्धः)
A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
विध to pierce, or व्यध to beat, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Having the ears pierced or slit.
mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी)
A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra, Rox.)
E.
विद्ध pierced, and कर्ण the ear; also in the latter sense, with कन् added विद्धकर्णिका; also अविद्धकर्ण, &c.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being, being present or in existence.
2 Actual, real, in possession, (as property.)
E.
विद to be, 4th cl. and शानच् aff.

f. (-द्या)
Knowledge, learning, science, whether sacred or profane, though more especially the former: it is sometimes classed into fourteen divisions; or the four Vedas; the six Aṅgas, or grammar, astronomy, &c.; the Purāṇas as the eleventh class; and the Mīmāṃsā or theology, Nyāya or logic, and Dharma or law, as the remaining three.
2 The goddess

DURGĀ.
3

A tree, (Premna spinosa.)
4 A magical pill or bolus, by putting which into the mouth a person has the power of ascending to heaven.
E.
विद to know, and aff. क्यप्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Giving wisdom or science.
m. (-रः)
A learned man.
E.
विद्या, and कर what makes, or आकर a mine: see विद्याघर.

m. (-मः)
Acquirement of knowledge.
E.
विद्या, and आगम coming.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Famous for learning or knowledge.
E.
विद्या knowledge, and चणप् aff. in this particular meaning.

mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्चु)
Famous for knowledge.
E.
विद्या knowledge, and चुञ्चुप् aff. implying celebrity.

m. (-लः)
The Bhojpatra tree.
E.
विद्या, and दल a leaf: being used for writing on.

n. (-नं)
Giving knowledge or science.
E.
विद्या, and दान giving.

f. (-वी)
A female divinity, one of a class of sixteen, peculiar apparently to the mythological system of the Jainas.
E.
विद्या science, and देवी a goddess; a goddess of learning or science, a muse.

n. (-नं)
Property acquired by science, as by instruction, &c.
E.
विद्या knowledge, and धन wealth.

m. (-रः)
A demigod of a particular order or class, a spirit of the air.
E.
विद्या a magical pill, as above, and धर who has or holds.

n. (-नं)
1 Patronising learning.
2 Studying, acquiring learning.
E.
विद्या, and अनुपालन encouraging.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Studied, acquiring or having acquired learning.
E.
विद्या, and अनुपालिन् who prosecutes.

n. (-नं)
Cultivating science or learning.
E.
विद्या, and अनुसेवन pursuing.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Cultivating learning, engaged in study.
E.
विद्या, and अनुसेविन् addicted to.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Acquirement of knowledge.
2 Acquisition made by or through learning.
E.
विद्या, and प्राप्ति gain.

m. (-सः)
Study, diligent application.
E.
विद्या, and अभ्यास exercise.

n. (-नं)
1 Acquiring knowledge.
2 Acquiring any thing by knowledge, as by teaching, &c.
E.
विद्या, and अर्ज्जन gaining.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gained by or through knowledge.
E.
विद्या, and अर्ज्जित obtained.

m. (-र्थः)
Seeking for knowledge.
E.
विद्या, and अर्थ object.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Seeking for knowledge.
m. (-र्थी)
A pupil, a student.
E.
विद्यार्थ, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Gained by or through learning.
E.
विद्या, and लब्ध gained.

m. (-यः)
A school, a college.
E.
विद्या, and आलय a house.

m. (-भः)
1 Acquisition of learning.
2 Acquirement by or through learning.
E.
विद्या, and लाभ gain.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Learned, possessed of learning or science.
E.
विद्या learning, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Possessed of learning or science.
E.
विद्या, and विशिष्ट endowed with.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ignorant, uninstructed.
E.
विद्या, and विहीन deprived of.

m. (-कः)
The Brahman who has finished his studies and period of studentship.
E.
विद्या, and व्रत a religious obligation, स्नातक a householder.

m. (-कः)
The student who has finished his religious studies.
E.
विद्या, and स्नातक a householder.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ignorant, uninstructed.
E.
विद्या, and हीन void of.

f. (-द्युत्)
Lightning.
E.
वि intensitive or privative, and द्युत light, lustre.

mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्)
Having or containing lightning, electrical, (a cloud, &c.)
E.
विद्युत् lightning, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-यं)
Bell-metal.
E.
विद्युत् lightning, and प्रिय beloved.

f. (-ता)
Zigzag lightning.
E.
विद्युत्, and लता a creeper.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shining, blazing, flashing.
E.
वि before द्युत to shine, शानच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Acquisition of knowledge.
E.
विद्या, and उपार्ज्जन collecting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Acquired by or through learning, &c.
E.
विद्या, and उपार्ज्जित obtained.

n. (-द्रं)
1 A hole, a chasm.
2 Piercing, perforating.
E.
विघ to pierce, aff. रक्, form irr., or वि before द्रा to sleep, aff. क.

m. (-धिः)
Phlegmonoid inflammation; especially deep seated, or internal abscess.
E.
विद्र piercing, धा to have, कि aff.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera Morunga.)
E.
विद्रधि a bile or abscess, नाशन destroying, discussing.

m. (-बः)
1 Flight, escape, retreat.
2 Fear, agitation, panic.
3 Intellect, understanding.
4 Censure, abuse, reproach.
5

Liquefaction.
6

Flowing out, oozing.
E.
वि before द्रु to fly, aff. अप्.

m. (-वः)
1 Flight, retreat, running away.
2 Liquefaction.
E.
वि before द्रु to go, causal v., aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Liquefying, causing to flow or melt.
2 Driving away.
E.
वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Causing to flow or melt, fusing, liquefying.
2 Driving away, chasing, defeating.
E.
वि before द्रु to run, &c. causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Liquefied, fused.
2 Driven away, put to flight.
E.
वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Liquid, liquefied, fluid, as an oily or metallic substance upon being heated.
2 Flown, fled.
3 Running, going fast.
4 Agitated, alarmed.
E.
वि before द्रु to ooze, &c., aff. क्त.

Coral.
2

A tree bearing precious gems.
3 A young sprout or shoot.
E.
वि implying species, and द्रुम a tree.

f. (-ता)
A sort of vegetable perfume.
E.
विद्रुम coral, and लता a creeper.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Less learned, a little learned.
E.
विद्वत् learned, and कल्प aff. of diminution or inferiority; also with the similar affs. देशीयर् and देश्य, विद्वद्देशीय and विद्वद्देश्य.

mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वत्)
1 Intelligent, wise.
2 Learned.
m. (-द्वान्)
A sage, a seer, one who knows the true nature of the soul and of GOD.
E.
विद to know, वसु aff. in lieu of शतृ, the usual affix of the present participle.

mfn. (-द्विट्)
An enemy.
E.
वि before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Hating, adverse, inimical.
m. (-षः)
An enemy.
E.
वि before द्विष to hate, aff. क.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Hated, disliked.
E.
वि before द्विष to hate, क्त aff.

m. (-षः)
Enmity, hatred.
E.
वि before द्विष to hate, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Inimical, hostile, hating.
m. (-षी)
An enemy.
E.
विद्वेष enmity, इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Who or what hates, adverse, inimical.
E.
वि before द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
